semantic_coverage_boundary.known_gap: PSC002 currently hashes raw canonical prompt records and does not bind the effective P02 override body.
semantic_coverage_boundary.local_guard: This matrix and its focused test bind the effective P02 override directly until the broader all-prompts effective-semantic audit is completed.

cases.title: AUTO orientation is not promoted to implementation
cases.stimulus: Operator asks to get bearings on a previous chat without asking for work to continue.
positive_assertions: Resolve AUTO to ORIENT and report current bearings without repository mutation merely to orient.
negative_assertions: Do not treat the existence of open work as authorization to execute it.
prompt_markers: AUTO: infer the disposition from the operator's current request.
ORIENT: answer where things stand
No repository mutation merely to provide bearings.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Summary preserves corrections and unresolved state
cases.stimulus: Operator asks for a faithful summary of a long previous conversation.
positive_assertions: Compress decisions, corrections, superseded state, disagreement, proof floors, and open questions.
negative_assertions: Do not smooth contradictions away or begin implementation because work remains.
prompt_markers: SUMMARIZE: compress the conversation faithfully
preserving decisions, corrections, superseded state, unresolved disagreement
Do not execute work merely because open work exists.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Closeout produces resumable state instead of a new sprint
cases.stimulus: Operator says the conversation is ending and wants a clean continuation surface.
positive_assertions: Emit a resumable checkpoint with first unproven gate, evidence anchors, blocker, next action, and proof ceiling.
negative_assertions: Do not start a fresh implementation slice merely because one is available.
prompt_markers: CLOSEOUT: produce a resumable durable handoff/checkpoint
first unproven gate
Do not start a new implementation slice merely because one is available.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Continue remains execution-first after alignment
cases.stimulus: Operator explicitly asks to continue unfinished implementation from a previous chat.
positive_assertions: Recover and align first, then select and execute the highest-value safe unfinished slice.
negative_assertions: Do not stop at orientation, summary, planning, branch status, or TODO output while safe execution remains.
prompt_markers: CONTINUE THAT CHAT AS AN ACTIVE IMPLEMENTATION SPRINT
planning is subordinate to implementation
SELECT THE FIRST UNFINISHED EXECUTION SLICE — CONTINUE ONLY
IMPLEMENT NOW — CONTINUE ONLY
VALIDATE AND DELIVER — CONTINUE ONLY
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Conversation fidelity and current reality remain independent axes
cases.stimulus: Conversation says work is open but current repository evidence says it is already merged.
positive_assertions: Recover what the conversation said and separately verify current repository reality before reconciliation.
negative_assertions: Do not let remembered intent overwrite current fact or current repository fact erase unresolved operator intent.
prompt_markers: AXIS A — CONVERSATION FIDELITY
AXIS B — CURRENT REALITY
Only after both axes are independently established
A passing conversation axis cannot erase a reality conflict.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Repository fallback cannot invent operator intent
cases.stimulus: Historical chat retrieval is unavailable but repository/provider truth is accessible.
positive_assertions: Reconstruct material implementation state from durable evidence and preserve unknown operator intent as unknown.
negative_assertions: Do not claim repository state reveals an unstated user decision.
prompt_markers: REPOSITORY RECONSTRUCTION FALLBACK
without pretending that repository truth reveals unstated operator intent
Loss of historical transcript or tool output is not itself a blocker
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Rich handoff bootstraps without transcript dependency
cases.stimulus: A supplied handoff is rich enough to start while transcript retrieval is incomplete.
positive_assertions: Use supplied context immediately and deepen or falsify it with history when available.
negative_assertions: Do not make transcript retrieval a prerequisite for safe current-truth inspection.
prompt_markers: PROVIDED-CONTEXT MODE
a rich pasted handoff is sufficient to begin
cannot block repository/provider inspection
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Later explicit correction supersedes earlier intent
cases.stimulus: The operator reverses or corrects an earlier decision later in the conversation.
positive_assertions: Preserve chronology and treat the later explicit correction as the active intent when it proves a real decision change.
negative_assertions: Do not average contradictory instructions or keep the older one because it appeared first.
prompt_markers: resolve state transitions and later superseding decisions
Later explicit operator corrections supersede earlier intent
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Reviewer findings remain hypotheses until anchors are checked
cases.stimulus: A recovery/review lane reports a consequential finding with a cited source.
positive_assertions: Verify consequential cited anchors before action.
negative_assertions: Do not promote a reviewer conclusion to fact merely because another agent emitted it.
prompt_markers: For consequential claims, verify the cited anchor before acting.
Reviewer output is a hypothesis until its evidence is checked.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Review converges by evidence change rather than repeated clean verdicts
cases.stimulus: First reconciliation completed and a second review pass finds no new material evidence.
positive_assertions: Run one deliberate contradiction/gap pass and stop reviewing when no material evidence changes.
negative_assertions: Do not repeatedly invoke review until a stochastic reviewer says clean.
prompt_markers: Run one deliberate contradiction/gap pass
Repeat only when the new pass changes material evidence.
Do not review repeatedly until an agent happens to say 'clean'.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: P02 recovery cannot recursively spawn P02
cases.stimulus: A sub-review lane notices that the task itself is conversation recovery.
positive_assertions: Keep P02 as single convergence owner while allowing independent evidence reviewers.
negative_assertions: Do not recursively invoke P02 from a P02 recovery or review lane.
prompt_markers: Do not recursively invoke P02 from a P02 recovery/review lane.
P02 remains the single convergence owner.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

cases.title: Checkpoint validity does not impersonate factual freshness
cases.stimulus: A structurally valid live-thread checkpoint is resumed after mutable provider state has changed.
positive_assertions: Preserve settled proof, refresh mutable anchors, and resume from the first unproven gate.
negative_assertions: Do not treat schema-valid checkpoint state as current provider truth.
prompt_markers: VALIDATED LIVE-THREAD CHECKPOINT MODE
Refresh mutable evidence anchors before treating them as current truth.
Structural checkpoint validity proves resumability, not factual freshness.
cases.proof_ceiling: Repository/static regression only; downstream model obedience remains unproven.

proof_ceiling: This matrix proves repository-owned static semantics and effective-override binding for P02. It does not prove downstream model obedience, external conversation-history availability, repository/provider access, or runtime action success.
